description: This file defines a React component named RoleCard used in the explore section of a career navigator app. It provides an interactive, expandable card UI displaying role details, including title, industry, salary, experience, description, skills, responsibilities, and compatibility scores. It manages state for expand/collapse, target role selection, and persona skills, and includes logic for user interactions and data fetching.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts input to a trimmed string, safely handling null or undefined values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Safely converts a value to an array of strings, filtering out invalid entries.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Transforms an array of strings into cleaned, properly punctuated bulleted sentences.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Clamps a number to the 0-100 range, ensuring it is a finite number.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID string from a role object, considering different possible field names.

methods.name: roleSalaryFromRole
methods.description: Derives a salary string for a role from various possible fields representing salary.

methods.name: roleExperienceFromRole
methods.description: Extracts experience information from a role object.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Extracts an array of skills from a persona object, considering multiple nested fields and ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Standardizes a skill string to lowercase for consistent comparison.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Returns array of skills that are both in personaSkills and requiredSkills, normalized and unique.
